items.subject: go
items.title: A missing map entry
items.failure: The first visit panics: assignment to entry in nil map.
items.goal: Count visits without panicking and test the initial visit.
items.solution: Initialize the map before assignment; a nil map supports reads but not writes.

items.subject: go
items.title: The loop skips a record
items.failure: Input [4, 9] produces 9; the empty input produces 0.
items.goal: Include every value exactly once.
items.solution: The loop starts at index one.

items.subject: go
items.title: The update disappears
items.failure: The slice still contains inactive users after activate returns.
items.goal: Update the original slice without replacing its identity.
items.solution: The range value is a copy; update through the slice index.

items.subject: go
items.title: An unexpected empty decode
items.failure: Decoding {"name":"Ada"} leaves the field empty.
items.goal: Decode the field and surface malformed input.
items.solution: encoding/json ignores unexported fields; exported fields/tags and error handling are needed.

items.subject: go
items.title: A stranded sender
items.failure: The function deadlocks before it returns.
items.goal: Explain the blocking trace and fix channel coordination.
items.solution: An unbuffered send requires a concurrent receiver.

items.subject: go
items.title: The ignored cancellation
items.failure: Canceling ctx does not stop a slow request.
items.goal: Propagate cancellation and test with a blocked test server.
items.solution: The request was created without the context; also handle request creation errors.

items.subject: go
items.title: A cache under load
items.code:
var cache = map[string]int{}
func update(k string) { cache[k]++ }
items.failure: Concurrent request handlers race on the cache and may crash.
items.goal: Preserve exact counts while synchronizing all accesses.
items.solution: Go maps are not safe for concurrent writes; the read-modify-write needs one synchronization boundary.

items.subject: go
items.title: A producer never finishes
items.failure: The consumer exits; cancellation then leaves the producer goroutine blocked.
items.goal: Make both cancellation and blocked sends terminate promptly.
items.solution: Cancellation must participate in a select with the send, not only be checked before it.

items.subject: go
items.title: A typed nil crosses an interface
items.failure: run() != nil is true; logging its Error can panic.
items.goal: Return a truly nil error for success and test interface values.
items.solution: The error interface has a dynamic type even though its dynamic pointer is nil.

items.subject: go
items.title: A bounded worker pipeline stalls
items.failure: With multiple jobs, Wait can block forever and cancellation is not handled.
items.goal: Design bounded consumption, closure ownership, cancellation, and a leak regression test.
items.solution: Producers block on the full results channel before Done; consume concurrently and close after producers finish.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: A fractional average
items.code: double Average(int total, int count) => total / count;
items.failure: Average(7, 2) returns 3.
items.goal: Return the fractional result and define behavior for zero count.
items.solution: Integer division happens before conversion to double.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: The missing key
items.code:
var scores = new Dictionary<string, int>();
Console.WriteLine(scores["Ada"]);
items.failure: Reading a player with no score throws KeyNotFoundException.
items.goal: Give missing players an explicit default without hiding other failures.
items.solution: The dictionary indexer requires the key to exist; use a missing-key-aware operation.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: A filtered sequence changes
items.failure: The count is zero although the query was created before Clear.
items.goal: Keep a snapshot of the selected values.
items.solution: LINQ deferred execution observes the collection at enumeration time.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: A struct update is lost
items.code:
struct Counter { public int Total; }
void Add(Counter counter) { counter.Total++; }
items.failure: The caller sees no change to Total.
items.goal: Choose and justify a value-returning or reference-passing contract.
items.solution: A struct is passed by value here.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: Invalid enumeration
items.failure: Removing an inactive user invalidates the List enumerator.
items.goal: Remove all inactive users without skipped entries.
items.solution: The collection is structurally modified during enumeration.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: An unobserved async failure
items.failure: The handler reports success before the write finishes and cannot await its failure.
items.goal: Make completion and errors observable to the caller.
items.solution: An async void method is unsuitable outside event handlers; propagate a Task and await it.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: A disposed result stream
items.failure: ReadLater lazily enumerates after Lines returns and the reader is disposed.
items.goal: Make resource lifetime include enumeration and test early disposal.
items.solution: The returned lazy sequence outlives its reader; ownership must follow the iterator.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: A thread-safe cache still duplicates work
items.code: var value = cache.GetOrAdd(key, _ => ChargeCard(order));
items.failure: ConcurrentDictionary remains valid, but two simultaneous requests can charge twice.
items.goal: Ensure the payment side effect has durable idempotency.
items.solution: GetOrAdd value factories may run more than once; dictionary safety is not exactly-once side-effect execution.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: An update is not atomic
items.failure: Two separate DbContexts load the same count and one increment is lost.
items.goal: Define a concurrency strategy, conflict handling, and a deterministic interleaving test.
items.solution: Read-modify-write across contexts requires optimistic concurrency or an atomic database update.

items.subject: csharp
items.title: A service captures scoped state
items.failure: A singleton retains a scoped DbContext and concurrent jobs fail or share state.
items.goal: Give each job a bounded service scope and correct disposal/cancellation.
items.solution: A captive scoped dependency violates lifetime and DbContext thread-safety constraints.

items.subject: html
items.title: A cancel button submits
items.code:
<form action="/save" method="post">
 <input name="name">
 <button>Cancel</button>
</form>
items.failure: Clicking Cancel submits the form.
items.goal: Provide a non-submitting cancel control.
items.solution: A button associated with a form defaults to submit.

items.subject: html
items.title: A false boolean attribute
items.code: <button disabled="false">Continue</button>
items.failure: The button is still disabled.
items.goal: Represent the enabled state correctly.
items.solution: Boolean attributes are true by presence, not by their string value.

items.subject: html
items.title: A label names the wrong input
items.code:
<label for="email">Email</label>
<input id="address" type="email">
items.failure: Clicking the label does not focus the input.
items.goal: Associate the visible label with its input.
items.solution: The for attribute and input id do not match.

items.subject: html
items.title: A missing submission value
items.code:
<form action="/search">
 <input id="query" value="graphs">
 <button>Search</button>
</form>
items.failure: The submitted query string does not include the typed term.
items.goal: Submit the named search field.
items.solution: The control lacks a name; an id does not provide a submission key.

items.subject: html
items.title: Nested forms behave unexpectedly
items.code:
<form id="outer"><input name="a">
 <form id="inner"><input name="b"></form>
 <button>Save</button></form>
items.failure: Parsed form ownership differs from source indentation.
items.goal: Use valid form structure and verify the actual DOM and form ownership.
items.solution: Nested forms are invalid and the parser repairs markup.

items.subject: html
items.title: A required field is ignored
items.code:
<form><input name="email" required disabled>
<button>Join</button></form>
items.failure: The empty email neither validates nor appears in the submission.
items.goal: Distinguish read-only data from disabled controls.
items.solution: Disabled controls are excluded from validation and form submission.

items.subject: html
items.title: Keyboard users cannot activate a control
items.code: Open settings
items.failure: The control can receive focus but Enter and Space do nothing.
items.goal: Provide native keyboard activation semantics and a test.
items.solution: A role and tabindex alone do not implement button behavior; prefer a real button.

items.subject: html
items.title: A table caption moves in the DOM
items.code:
Monthly totals
42
items.failure: Text appears outside the table after parsing.
items.goal: Use the correct table content model and preserve the accessible caption.
items.solution: Raw text in a table triggers parser repair; a caption is the appropriate element.

items.subject: html
items.title: Duplicate IDs corrupt associations
items.code:
<label for="user">Account owner</label><input id="user">
<label for="user">Backup owner</label><input id="user">
items.failure: Assistive-technology and label targeting become ambiguous in repeated rows.
items.goal: Generate unique stable identifiers and test associations after reordering rows.
items.solution: IDs must be unique; repeated label targets attach incorrectly.

items.subject: html
items.title: A custom modal traps users outside
items.code: Confirm removal
items.failure: Tab reaches background controls and closing loses the original focus.
items.goal: Specify a complete focus, dismissal, background-inertness and accessible-name contract.
items.solution: aria-modal declares semantics but does not implement focus management or background inertness.

items.subject: css
items.title: A size rule never applies
items.code: .card { width: 320; }
items.failure: The card keeps its auto width.
items.goal: Apply a valid explicit width.
items.solution: Nonzero CSS lengths require units.

items.subject: css
items.title: The child selector misses
items.code:
.panel > .title { color: navy; }
/* DOM: panel > header > title */
items.failure: The nested heading does not get the color.
items.goal: Choose a selector that matches the intended nesting.
items.solution: The direct-child combinator does not match a grandchild.

items.subject: css
items.title: The flex gap overflows
items.code:
.row { display: flex; width: 300px; gap: 20px; }
.item { flex: 0 0 50%; }
items.failure: Two items plus the gap exceed the row width.
items.goal: Allocate the gap as part of the layout budget.
items.solution: Two 50% bases plus a gap exceed 100%; allow flexible distribution or account for the gap.

items.subject: css
items.title: A border grows the card
items.code: .card { width: 300px; padding: 20px; border: 2px solid; box-sizing: content-box; }
items.failure: The outer card is 344px wide rather than 300px.
items.goal: Keep total width at 300px.
items.solution: Content-box excludes padding and borders from the specified width.

items.subject: css
items.title: An ellipsis never appears
items.code: .title { text-overflow: ellipsis; }
items.failure: The title remains on multiple lines and never ellipsizes.
items.goal: Provide the size, overflow and white-space conditions for one-line ellipsis.
items.solution: text-overflow alone does not create overflow or prevent wrapping.

items.subject: css
items.title: A sticky panel does not stick
items.code:
.viewport { overflow: auto; height: 100vh; }
.sidebar { position: sticky; }
items.failure: The sidebar scrolls away instead of sticking.
items.goal: Define the relevant scroll container and a sticky inset.
items.solution: Sticky positioning needs an inset and is bounded by its scroll/containing block.

items.subject: css
items.title: A dialog loses a stacking contest
items.failure: The dialog inside shell stays below the sibling overlay.
items.goal: Map stacking contexts before choosing a placement strategy.
items.solution: A child cannot escape its ancestor stacking context with a larger z-index.

items.subject: css
items.title: A grid refuses to shrink
items.code:
.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; width: 320px; }
.cell { white-space: nowrap; }
items.failure: A long unbroken value forces the grid wider than the viewport.
items.goal: Control min-content sizing without losing the content.
items.solution: The automatic minimum track/item size can prevent shrinking; consider minmax(0,1fr) and intentional overflow.

items.subject: css
items.title: A theme rule breaks its own token
items.code:
:root { --accent: var(--button); --button: var(--accent); }
.button { background: var(--accent); }
items.failure: The background becomes invalid at computed-value time.
items.goal: Remove the custom-property dependency cycle and test fallback behavior.
items.solution: The two custom properties form a cycle; both become invalid.

items.subject: css
items.title: A low-specificity rule still wins
items.failure: The button is red despite the later layer and ID selector.
items.goal: Explain important-layer reversal and choose a maintainable override.
items.solution: For important declarations the layer order reverses; earlier layers outrank later layers before specificity.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: A parameter comes from the wrong place
items.failure: Posting a JSON object with name produces a validation error about a query parameter.
items.goal: Accept the intended JSON request contract.
items.solution: A plain scalar parameter is interpreted as a query parameter unless body handling is declared.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: An integer route rejects its identifier
items.failure: GET /items/current is rejected, but current is a supported alias in the product contract.
items.goal: Represent the alias and numeric identifier routes without ambiguity.
items.solution: The path parameter is validated as an int; a separate explicit alias route or different contract is needed.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: A dependency is never called
items.failure: The handler receives a function object instead of the authenticated user.
items.goal: Declare dependency injection rather than using a Python default value.
items.solution: The function was not wrapped in Depends.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: A response violates its schema
items.failure: A request that reaches the handler fails response validation.
items.goal: Satisfy the public response contract without relaxing unrelated validation.
items.solution: The required response field name is missing.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: One route blocks unrelated requests
items.failure: Concurrent requests stall while a report sleeps.
items.goal: Keep blocking work off the event loop and demonstrate concurrent responsiveness.
items.solution: A blocking sleep runs on the event-loop thread inside an async route.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: Validation is bypassed by construction
items.failure: A negative quantity reaches order processing under Pydantic 2.
items.goal: Ensure untrusted request data is validated.
items.solution: model_construct deliberately bypasses validation.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: State leaks across requests
items.failure: One user sees another user’s events.
items.goal: Choose request-local or explicitly user-scoped storage and test isolation.
items.solution: Dependency caching is per request, but this factory returns the same process-global list.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: Tests change the next test’s behavior
items.code:
app.dependency_overrides[current_user] = lambda: admin
response = client.get("/admin")
items.failure: A later test unexpectedly has administrator identity.
items.goal: Restore dependency overrides even when the test fails.
items.solution: The test modifies shared app state without a scoped cleanup/finally fixture.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: A background job uses a closed resource
items.failure: A worker sometimes receives a closed or request-owned session; cleanup timing depends on the deployed version.
items.goal: Define independent job resource ownership and a version-pinned lifetime test.
items.solution: A background task must acquire its own session instead of retaining request dependency state.

items.subject: python-fastapi
items.title: Streaming and teardown disagree
items.failure: A deployment change causes iteration after dependency cleanup, or an open transaction persists for an unexpectedly long stream.
items.goal: Pin FastAPI/Starlette behavior, choose explicit stream/session lifetimes, and test disconnect cleanup.
items.solution: Yield-dependency cleanup timing has varied; the generator must own a resource whose lifetime matches iteration.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: The view returns the wrong type
items.code:
def hello(request):
    return {"message": "hello"}
items.failure: Django cannot treat the plain dictionary as a valid response.
items.goal: Return a valid JSON HTTP response.
items.solution: A view must return an HttpResponse-compatible object, such as JsonResponse.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: An integer converter meets a slug
items.code: urlpatterns = [path("posts/<int:pk>/", detail)]
items.failure: GET /posts/first-post/ returns 404.
items.goal: Match the URL contract used by the post links.
items.solution: The int converter does not match a slug.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: A form saves before validation
items.failure: Invalid submissions raise or try to persist data instead of displaying field errors.
items.goal: Validate and return the bound form on failure.
items.solution: The view calls save before checking is_valid.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: An empty query crashes
items.failure: The first launch has no published posts and raises IndexError.
items.goal: Handle the no-result state deliberately.
items.solution: Indexing a possibly empty QuerySet assumes a row exists.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: A detail page runs a query per row
items.failure: Listing 100 orders performs roughly 101 queries.
items.goal: Eliminate the N+1 pattern for a foreign-key relation.
items.solution: Fetch the customer relation with the order rows, e.g. select_related.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: A user filter escapes its owner
items.failure: An authenticated user can request another user’s private note ID.
items.goal: Apply object ownership before returning the record.
items.solution: Authentication alone does not enforce object-level authorization; scope the query to the owner.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: Two updates overwrite each other
items.code:
counter = Counter.objects.get(pk=1)
counter.value += 1
counter.save()
items.failure: Concurrent requests lose increments.
items.goal: Make the database operation atomic and define a concurrency test.
items.solution: Read-modify-save in separate requests races; use an appropriate database expression or row locking.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: A signal publishes too soon
items.failure: A worker sometimes cannot find the order, or sees an order from a rolled-back transaction.
items.goal: Publish only after a successful commit.
items.solution: post_save can run within an uncommitted transaction; use transaction.on_commit for the enqueue boundary.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: A uniqueness check races
items.failure: Two transactions create reservations for the same slot.
items.goal: Enforce the invariant in the database and handle conflicts.
items.solution: A prior exists check does not lock a nonexistent row; a unique constraint is needed.

items.subject: python-django
items.title: External effects survive a rollback
items.code:
with transaction.atomic():
    order = Order.objects.create(owner=request.user)
    send_receipt(order)
    reserve_stock(order)  # raises
items.failure: No order remains in the database, but the receipt was sent.
items.goal: Design an idempotent post-commit/outbox flow with recovery and fault-injection tests.
items.solution: A database rollback cannot undo external effects; commit and delivery boundaries need a durable design.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: A route never matches the expected method
items.failure: POST /login returns Method Not Allowed.
items.goal: Declare the route’s intended methods.
items.solution: The route defaults to GET (with related automatic methods), not POST.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: A view falls through
items.failure: When ready is false Flask reports that the view did not return a valid response.
items.goal: Return a valid response on every branch.
items.solution: The false branch returns None.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: A blueprint is missing
items.failure: The health route returns 404 from the factory-created app.
items.goal: Register the blueprint on every intended app instance.
items.solution: Defining a blueprint does not register it on an app.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: Configuration uses the wrong shape
items.failure: Writing a session fails because no secret key is configured.
items.goal: Load a deployment secret before serving session routes.
items.solution: Signed session support needs a secret key; never substitute a hard-coded production key.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: A request proxy outlives its request
items.failure: The background worker raises Working outside of request context.
items.goal: Copy and validate required values before crossing the task boundary.
items.solution: request is a context-local proxy, not an ordinary globally available request object.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: The global database session leaks
items.failure: Concurrent requests share transaction state and errors poison subsequent requests.
items.goal: Bound session ownership to a request or job and ensure teardown.
items.solution: A single global session is not a request-safe transaction boundary.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: An async task disappears
items.code:
@app.get("/start")
async def start():
    asyncio.create_task(rebuild_index())
    return "started"
items.failure: Under Flask’s ordinary WSGI async-view lifecycle, the background task is canceled when the view finishes.
items.goal: Move durable background work to an independently managed worker.
items.solution: An async view’s event loop is not a durable task scheduler in the normal WSGI deployment.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: An extension belongs to the first app
items.code:
app = Flask(__name__)
db = SQLAlchemy(app)
def create_app(config):
    other = Flask(__name__)
    other.config.update(config)
    return other
items.failure: Tests using the second app report that the app is not registered with the extension.
items.goal: Initialize the extension consistently in the factory.
items.solution: The extension is bound only to a different app instance.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: A streamed response loses context
items.failure: The generator runs after view return and the request proxy is unavailable.
items.goal: Define streaming context ownership and test early disconnects.
items.solution: Use an appropriate stream-with-context pattern or copy necessary data before iteration.

items.subject: python-flask
items.title: Signed session updates are lost
items.failure: Two simultaneous requests based on the same signed cookie both return the same increment; one update is lost.
items.goal: Define authoritative server-side state and concurrent update semantics.
items.solution: Client-side cookie sessions are independent snapshots; signatures do not provide transactional concurrency control.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: A manually created service is missing dependencies
items.failure: The service has a null dependency.
items.goal: Trace who creates the service and owns injection.
items.solution: Objects created directly with new are not automatically managed by Spring.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: Two candidates look identical
items.failure: Context startup fails with multiple Sender candidates.
items.goal: Make the dependency selection unambiguous.
items.solution: Injection by type has two candidates; use an explicit qualifier or appropriate primary candidate.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: An intended bean is not registered
items.failure: Startup cannot find a Clock bean.
items.goal: Register the factory method as a bean.
items.solution: The method lacks @Bean.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: A lifecycle callback is invisible
items.failure: connect is never called through the expected lifecycle.
items.goal: Use the appropriate managed lifecycle.
items.solution: The directly constructed instance is not undergoing container lifecycle callbacks.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: A prototype behaves like a singleton
items.failure: Each run reuses the same Task instance in the singleton Runner.
items.goal: Obtain a fresh task for each operation.
items.solution: A prototype injected once is resolved once; use a provider or another explicit lookup boundary.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: A field value arrives too late
items.failure: The constructor sees a null URL although the property exists.
items.goal: Make required configuration available before use.
items.solution: Field injection occurs after construction; constructor injection or a later lifecycle boundary is needed.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: A bean depends on itself during initialization
items.code:
@Component class A { A(B b) {} }
@Component class B { B(A a) {} }
items.failure: The context cannot satisfy the constructor dependency cycle.
items.goal: Remove the architectural cycle rather than making construction order accidental.
items.solution: Two constructor dependencies form an unsatisfiable cycle without a redesigned boundary.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: Proxy advice never runs
items.failure: Repeated external quote calls still invoke db.
items.goal: Trace the call path through or around the proxy.
items.solution: Self-invocation does not traverse the Spring proxy that provides caching advice.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: Request data becomes singleton state
items.failure: Concurrent requests sometimes format another user’s data.
items.goal: Make shared-service state and ownership explicit and prove isolation.
items.solution: The singleton stores mutable request-specific state; keep it local or correctly scoped.

items.subject: spring-core
items.title: An asynchronous handoff loses thread-local context
items.failure: The worker sees no authentication or the wrong inherited context under a reused thread.
items.goal: Define safe context capture/propagation and cleanup on pooled threads.
items.solution: Thread-local request/security context does not automatically follow arbitrary executor tasks.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A controller is outside scanning
items.failure: The app starts, but /health returns 404.
items.goal: Check component scanning boundaries.
items.solution: Default scanning begins at the application class package and its descendants.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A property name disagrees
items.failure: Startup cannot resolve the timeout placeholder.
items.goal: Align the property contract and inject a correctly typed value.
items.solution: The requested placeholder is a different property name.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A test configuration leaks into production
items.failure: Production unexpectedly uses the fake gateway.
items.goal: Constrain test-only beans to the test environment.
items.solution: A normally scanned configuration is not test-only just because its class name says Fake.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A runner exits before its work finishes
items.failure: A short-lived batch app reports startup completion while import failures disappear.
items.goal: Define batch completion and error propagation.
items.solution: Submitting work does not await it or propagate failures to the runner.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: Configuration is silently unbound
items.failure: Injecting BillingProperties fails although the properties file exists.
items.goal: Register the binding type and validate the required fields.
items.solution: The annotation alone does not register an arbitrary type as a bean without registration/scanning.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A unit test connects to real infrastructure
items.failure: The test unexpectedly needs the production database and network.
items.goal: Choose an appropriate test scope and explicitly replace external boundaries.
items.solution: A full context test loads real configuration unless the test constrains or replaces those beans.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A startup check races with readiness
items.failure: The load balancer sends traffic before the required index is available.
items.goal: Align readiness with the completion of required initialization.
items.solution: An asynchronously submitted warmup is not completed merely because a ready event fired.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A deployment overrides the wrong source
items.failure: Operators edit the packaged file but the feature stays enabled.
items.goal: Identify the effective property source rather than guessing from one file.
items.solution: Externalized configuration precedence allows the environment to override packaged defaults.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: A shutdown drops queued work
items.failure: Graceful shutdown loses in-flight writes while readiness remains advertised.
items.goal: Design readiness withdrawal, bounded draining, and idempotent recovery.
items.solution: Abrupt interruption does not provide a drain protocol or durable work ownership.

items.subject: spring-boot
items.title: Multiple instances run the same scheduled job
items.failure: Two Boot instances can charge the same pending order during concurrent schedules.
items.goal: Define distributed claim/idempotency boundaries and a crash-between-steps test.
items.solution: A local scheduler provides no distributed exclusivity or exactly-once side effects.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: A derived query names a nonexistent field
items.failure: Repository initialization reports that the property cannot be found.
items.goal: Match the query method to mapped property names.
items.solution: Derived query parsing uses entity properties.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: A missing entity is unwrapped
items.code: User user = users.findById(id).get();
items.failure: An unknown ID throws NoSuchElementException.
items.goal: Make the missing-record contract explicit.
items.solution: Optional.get assumes presence.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: A write query is treated as a read
items.code:
@Query("update User u set u.active = false where u.id = :id")
void deactivate(@Param("id") long id);
items.failure: The update query cannot execute through the repository method as declared.
items.goal: Declare update-query behavior and an appropriate transaction.
items.solution: An explicit update query needs modifying-query semantics and a transaction boundary.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: Pagination starts on the wrong page
items.code: Page<User> first = users.findAll(PageRequest.of(1, 20));
items.failure: The first twenty users are absent from the supposed first page.
items.goal: Respect the page-index contract.
items.solution: PageRequest indexes pages from zero.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: Lazy state escapes its transaction
items.failure: With no open session and an uninitialized collection, the caller gets a lazy-initialization failure.
items.goal: Choose an intentional fetch/DTO boundary.
items.solution: A lazy association is accessed after the persistence context closes.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: Bulk updates leave stale entities
items.failure: The returned value still reflects the old active state.
items.goal: Explain bulk-update persistence-context behavior and avoid stale reads.
items.solution: JPQL bulk updates bypass managed entity state; refresh/clear or a different update strategy is needed.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: A transactional method is called internally
items.failure: External place calls do not get the intended transaction around saveAll.
items.goal: Make the transaction boundary cross the managed proxy.
items.solution: Self-invocation bypasses proxy-based transaction advice.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: An exception is swallowed
items.failure: The service can commit an order even though stock reservation failed.
items.goal: Define the failure and rollback contract explicitly.
items.solution: Swallowing the exception can hide the failure from the transaction interceptor; actual resource rollback-only state also matters.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: Two writers silently lose a change
items.failure: After both writes the amount is 90 rather than 80.
items.goal: Specify optimistic versioning or a suitable atomic/locking update and retry policy.
items.solution: The entity has no concurrency-control mechanism for the read-modify-write invariant.

items.subject: spring-data
items.title: Offset pages skip moving records
items.failure: Some pending jobs are skipped as processed rows disappear from the filtered set.
items.goal: Design stable traversal under mutation and concurrent workers.
items.solution: Increasing offsets over a shrinking result set skip records; use stable keyset/claim semantics.

items.subject: spring-mvc
items.title: A return value becomes a view name
items.failure: The application looks for a hello template instead of returning plain text.
items.goal: Declare the intended HTTP body semantics.
items.solution: A plain Controller string return is normally a view name without response-body semantics.

items.subject: spring-mvc
items.title: A path value is read as a query
items.code:
@GetMapping("/users/{id}")
User read(@RequestParam long id) { return users.find(id); }
items.failure: GET /users/42 complains about a missing request parameter.
items.goal: Bind the identifier from its declared URL location.
items.solution: RequestParam does not bind the path variable.

items.subject: spring-mvc
items.title: JSON is not bound to the DTO
items.code:
@PostMapping("/users")
User create(UserInput input) { return users.save(input); }
items.failure: A JSON request body does not populate input as intended.
items.goal: Use the intended JSON-body binding contract.
items.solution: A complex parameter without RequestBody follows model-attribute binding rather than JSON message conversion.

items.subject: spring-mvc
items.title: A route assumes every value is an integer
items.code:
@GetMapping("/reports/{year}")
Report report(@PathVariable int year) { return service.load(year); }
items.failure: The documented /reports/latest URL fails conversion.
items.goal: Distinguish aliases and numeric route values.
items.solution: latest does not satisfy the int conversion contract.

items.subject: spring-mvc
items.title: Constraints never run
items.failure: A blank name reaches the service despite Jakarta Bean Validation constraints.
items.goal: Activate request-body validation and preserve error responses.
items.solution: The controller parameter lacks the appropriate validation trigger such as Valid.

items.subject: spring-mvc
items.title: An error handler returns success
items.code:
@ExceptionHandler(NotFound.class)
Map<String,String> missing() { return Map.of("error", "missing"); }
items.failure: The body describes a missing resource but the HTTP response is 200.
items.goal: Return the correct HTTP status alongside the error body.
items.solution: An exception handler does not infer a status solely from its method name or message.

items.subject: spring-mvc
items.title: A controller retains request data
items.failure: Two concurrent searches can observe a different request’s term.
items.goal: Keep request values local and test an interleaving.
items.solution: Controllers are commonly singletons; mutable per-request fields race.

items.subject: spring-mvc
items.title: A permissive binder accepts internal state
items.failure: A crafted form modifies fields that the profile page never displays.
items.goal: Limit the binding surface and enforce server-owned fields.
items.solution: Binding an entity with privileged writable properties enables mass assignment.

items.subject: spring-mvc
items.title: A redirect target is trusted
items.code:
@GetMapping("/done")
String done(@RequestParam String next) { return "redirect:" + next; }
items.failure: An external next URL sends users to another origin.
items.goal: Define and validate an allowed local redirect contract.
items.solution: An untrusted redirect target can become an open redirect; parsing and normalization matter.

items.subject: spring-mvc
items.title: A stream depends on request-thread state
items.failure: Asynchronous response writing observes a missing or closed thread-bound transaction/session.
items.goal: Make stream resource ownership, cancellation, and transaction bounds explicit.
items.solution: Thread-bound request transactions do not automatically span deferred streaming work.

items.subject: spring-security
items.title: A route rule is too broad
items.failure: Anonymous users can open /admin routes.
items.goal: Place specific authorization decisions before broad matches.
items.solution: The first matching rule wins; the broad permit rule shadows the admin rule.

items.subject: spring-security
items.title: A role has a doubled prefix
items.code:
http.authorizeHttpRequests(a -> a
 .requestMatchers("/admin/**").hasRole("ROLE_ADMIN"));
items.failure: Users with the intended admin authority do not get the expected result, or configuration rejects the role string.
items.goal: Use role and authority APIs with their correct prefix contract.
items.solution: hasRole applies the role prefix; use ADMIN or an authority check for ROLE_ADMIN.

items.subject: spring-security
items.title: Method constraints are not active
items.failure: The annotation does not prevent calls in the expected application configuration.
items.goal: Enable the intended method-security mechanism and test it through a managed bean.
items.solution: The method annotation requires method-security infrastructure.

items.subject: spring-security
items.title: A custom filter is never in the chain
items.failure: The custom token logic never runs for protected requests.
items.goal: Register the filter in the intended chain at the correct position.
items.solution: Defining a filter class alone does not place it in a Spring Security filter chain.

items.subject: spring-security
items.title: A CSRF failure is mistaken for login failure
items.code:
// Session-cookie application, CSRF protection enabled
mockMvc.perform(post("/settings").with(user("ada")));
items.failure: An authenticated form-style POST receives 403 in a security-enabled test.
items.goal: Test the legitimate CSRF-protected request rather than disabling protection.
items.solution: Authentication does not supply a CSRF token.

items.subject: spring-security
items.title: A policy checks identity but not ownership
items.code:
@PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
Document read(long id) { return documents.get(id); }
items.failure: A logged-in user can read a document belonging to another account.
items.goal: Enforce object authorization at the data-access boundary.
items.solution: Authenticated is not equivalent to authorized for a particular record.

items.subject: spring-security
items.title: A worker loses its principal
items.code: executor.submit(() -> audit(SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication()));
items.failure: Audit events from reused executor threads have missing authentication.
items.goal: Use explicit principal capture or a deliberate security-context propagation mechanism.
items.solution: SecurityContext is normally thread-bound and is not automatically propagated to arbitrary executors.

items.subject: spring-security
items.title: A broad filter chain hides another
items.failure: The API chain is never chosen for /api requests.
items.goal: Constrain chain selection as well as authorization within a chain.
items.solution: The higher-priority chain matches all requests before the API chain is considered.

items.subject: spring-security
items.title: A session survives account suspension
items.failure: An already logged-in suspended user continues to access protected data.
items.goal: Define revocation, status checks, session invalidation, and cache freshness.
items.solution: Persisted authentication can outlive current account entitlement unless access rechecks or invalidation enforce revocation.

items.subject: spring-security
items.title: A token is decoded but never verified
items.code:
String payload = new String(Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(token.split("\.")[1]));
return principalFromJson(payload);
items.failure: Editing the token payload changes the accepted identity.
items.goal: Specify signature, issuer/audience, time, and key-rotation validation through a supported verifier.
items.solution: Decoding an encoded payload is not cryptographic token verification.

items.subject: spring-testing
items.title: A test method is never run
items.failure: The build reports no execution of computesTotal.
items.goal: Make the test discoverable under JUnit Jupiter.
items.solution: The method lacks a Jupiter Test annotation (or another test discovery annotation).

items.subject: spring-testing
items.title: The mock never reaches the service
items.failure: The real inventory is called rather than the stub.
items.goal: Inject the test double into the object under test.
items.solution: The mock is disconnected from the service instance.

items.subject: spring-testing
items.title: A slice test needs an unrelated bean
items.failure: The MVC test context cannot satisfy the service dependency.
items.goal: Provide the service boundary deliberately without loading the whole production app.
items.solution: A web slice does not load arbitrary service beans; supply a supported test replacement.

items.subject: spring-testing
items.title: A mutable fixture crosses tests
items.failure: Results depend on execution order.
items.goal: Isolate fixture state for each test.
items.solution: Static mutable test state is shared across test executions.

items.subject: spring-testing
items.title: An async assertion passes too early
items.failure: The test passes while a later background failure goes unnoticed.
items.goal: Await a meaningful completion signal and assert the intended published outcome.
items.solution: The assertion runs before asynchronous work completes and checks the wrong observable.

items.subject: spring-testing
items.title: A rollback test hides an integration effect
items.failure: Database changes roll back after the test, but external email was actually sent.
items.goal: Replace external boundaries and distinguish transactional rollback from side-effect rollback.
items.solution: The test transaction cannot undo external mail delivery.

items.subject: spring-testing
items.title: Security is absent from a standalone controller test
items.code:
MockMvc mvc = MockMvcBuilders.standaloneSetup(new AdminController()).build();
mvc.perform(get("/admin")).andExpect(status().isOk());
items.failure: A passing test is used as proof that anonymous access is forbidden.
items.goal: Test authorization with the actual intended security chain.
items.solution: Standalone controller setup does not prove the behavior of the deployed security filter chain.

items.subject: spring-testing
items.title: A concurrency test has no overlap
items.failure: The supposed race test never exposes a lost update.
items.goal: Coordinate overlapping read/write phases with barriers.
items.solution: Waiting for the first task before submitting the second serializes the test.

items.subject: spring-testing
items.title: The test never crosses a transaction proxy
items.failure: The test claims rollback coverage even though no managed transaction interceptor runs.
items.goal: Exercise a real transactional boundary and verify persisted state independently.
items.solution: A directly instantiated service has no Spring proxy; the annotation alone does nothing.

items.subject: spring-testing
items.title: A fault test misses the duplicate-delivery window
items.failure: The test passes but does not cover a crash after the charge succeeds and before the local commit.
items.goal: Inject failure after the external side effect and test idempotent recovery.
items.solution: Only testing pre-side-effect failures does not validate the critical uncertain-outcome retry window.

items.subject: bootstrap
items.title: A grid has no row
items.code:
A
B
items.failure: Bootstrap 5 columns do not behave as the intended two-column row.
items.goal: Use the framework’s container/row/column structure.
items.solution: Columns need an appropriate row parent for the grid layout and gutter model.

items.subject: bootstrap
items.title: A breakpoint is backwards
items.code: Card
items.failure: The card is half width on mobile and full width at md, opposite the design.
items.goal: Use full mobile width and half width at md and above.
items.solution: Bootstrap breakpoint classes apply from that minimum width upward.

items.subject: bootstrap
items.title: An obsolete modal trigger
items.code: ...
items.failure: With Bootstrap 5 JavaScript loaded, clicking Open does nothing.
items.goal: Match the Bootstrap 5 data-attribute contract.
items.solution: The trigger uses older data-toggle/data-target names instead of the Bootstrap 5 bs-prefixed attributes.

items.subject: bootstrap
items.title: Spacing moved to the wrong side
items.code: Name
items.failure: The spacing is on the right although the design requested a fixed physical left margin.
items.goal: Distinguish logical start/end from physical left/right in the design requirement.
items.solution: ms follows inline start, which reverses in RTL; decide whether the requirement should be logical or physical.

items.subject: bootstrap
items.title: A dropdown is only styled
items.code: ...
items.failure: The menu never opens.
items.goal: Include the matching interaction assets and preserve accessible markup.
items.solution: CSS does not implement the dropdown plugin; the matching JavaScript/positioning dependencies are needed.

items.subject: bootstrap
items.title: A nested grid overflows
items.code:
Parent
Child
items.failure: The child width and gutters are calculated against the wrong structure.
items.goal: Give the nested grid its own row inside the parent column.
items.solution: A nested column needs its own row context.

items.subject: bootstrap
items.title: A hidden utility fights a display utility
items.code: Status
items.failure: Status vanishes on large screens although it should remain visible after md.
items.goal: Trace the active display rules at every breakpoint.
items.solution: The lg utility explicitly restores display:none at lg and above.

items.subject: bootstrap
items.title: Disabled styling leaves a live link
items.code: Delete
items.failure: The link remains a navigation target in keyboard/programmatic interaction.
items.goal: Represent an unavailable action with appropriate semantics and behavior.
items.solution: Visual disabled styling on an anchor is not the same as a native disabled button; href/keyboard behavior must be handled.

items.subject: bootstrap
items.title: Custom CSS loses to utility importance
items.code: Dialog
items.failure: The custom dialog display rule never becomes visible.
items.goal: Resolve the class/state conflict without accumulating arbitrary specificity.
items.solution: A normal declaration cannot override an important utility merely by appearing later.

items.subject: bootstrap
items.title: A modal is trapped in a transformed shell
items.code: ...
items.failure: The modal is clipped or participates in an unexpected stacking context.
items.goal: Place modal markup at an appropriate document level and test focus/backdrop behavior.
items.solution: Transformed/overflow ancestors change containing and stacking behavior; raising an inner z-index alone is insufficient.

items.subject: bulma
items.title: A column lives outside its container
items.code:
One
Two
items.failure: The intended Bulma row is not formed.
items.goal: Provide the correct columns container.
items.solution: Bulma column layout needs a columns parent.

items.subject: bulma
items.title: A tile uses the wrong modifier
items.code: <button class="button primary">Save</button>
items.failure: The button is not given the intended primary appearance.
items.goal: Use the documented modifier naming.
items.solution: The Bulma modifier is is-primary.

items.subject: bulma
items.title: A mobile layout never activates
items.code:
A
B
items.failure: The columns stack on mobile although the design calls for two columns.
items.goal: Choose an explicit mobile-column behavior.
items.solution: Bulma columns stack on mobile unless the appropriate mobile modifier is used.

items.subject: bulma
items.title: A select wrapper is missing
items.code: <select class="select"><option>One</option></select>
items.failure: The select does not receive the expected Bulma wrapper styling.
items.goal: Use the framework’s select wrapper structure.
items.solution: The select class belongs on the wrapper around the native select.

items.subject: bulma
items.title: A burger is inert
items.code: Links
items.failure: The mobile navbar never opens when clicked.
items.goal: Implement and test the interaction and expanded-state accessibility.
items.solution: Bulma provides CSS; it does not ship JavaScript that automatically toggles this navbar.

items.subject: bulma
items.title: A modal has only a class name
items.code: Confirm
items.failure: The modal remains hidden after application state says it is open.
items.goal: Synchronize application state with the framework’s active state.
items.solution: Bulma modal visibility is driven by an active modifier; CSS classes alone do not observe app state.

items.subject: bulma
items.title: A full-width field shrinks in a group
items.failure: The input does not expand to fill the remaining grouped width.
items.goal: Assign expansion behavior to the correct control wrapper.
items.solution: The input width is bounded by its control; the expanding modifier belongs on the control wrapper.

items.subject: bulma
items.title: Disabled appearance has no native effect
items.code: <button class="button is-static">Delete</button>
items.failure: Keyboard activation still invokes the action although the UI looks inactive.
items.goal: Use actual disabled semantics for an unavailable action.
items.solution: is-static is a visual presentation modifier, not a disabled attribute.

items.subject: bulma
items.title: Dark-theme overrides target the wrong token
items.code:
:root { --brand-primary: #135; }
.button.is-primary { background: var(--bulma-primary); }
items.failure: Changing brand-primary does not affect the component.
items.goal: Trace the actual token consumed by the selected Bulma version.
items.solution: The custom token is disconnected from the variable the rule reads; versioned variable names/values must be mapped intentionally.

items.subject: bulma
items.title: A modal passes visual QA but breaks navigation
items.code: Background account
items.failure: Focus can leave the modal and the background remains interactive.
items.goal: Specify a complete modal interaction contract, not only the CSS state.
items.solution: Bulma modal styling does not implement focus trapping, inert background, escape handling, or focus restoration.

items.subject: tailwind
items.title: A utility is misspelled
items.code: Name
items.failure: Alignment has no visible effect because the element is not a flex container.
items.goal: Use a valid display utility before alignment utilities.
items.solution: flexx is not the flex utility.

items.subject: tailwind
items.title: A responsive utility starts too late
items.code: Mobile help
items.failure: The mobile help is hidden on small screens.
items.goal: State the intended visibility at each breakpoint.
items.solution: Responsive prefixes are minimum-width conditions, not labels for smaller devices.

items.subject: tailwind
items.title: A class name is assembled at runtime
items.code: Badge
items.failure: The color works only when the same complete class appears elsewhere in scanned source.
items.goal: Expose complete class candidates to the Tailwind build.
items.solution: The source scanner cannot infer arbitrary runtime string interpolation.

items.subject: tailwind
items.title: A state variant has no state
items.code: <button class="disabled:opacity-50">Submit</button>
items.failure: The button remains fully opaque and clickable.
items.goal: Connect the style variant to actual disabled control state.
items.solution: A disabled variant matches only a disabled state; it does not create that state.

items.subject: tailwind
items.title: An overflowing child defeats a flex layout
items.code: a-very-long-unbroken-value
items.failure: The long value pushes the button outside the container.
items.goal: Control automatic minimum sizing and intentional text overflow.
items.solution: Flex items may need a zero minimum width plus a deliberate overflow policy.

items.subject: tailwind
items.title: A utility never gets generated
items.code:
@import "tailwindcss" source(none);
/* project templates live in ./views; no @source declarations */
items.failure: In a Tailwind 4 project, classes used in templates are absent from output CSS.
items.goal: Configure the actual template sources explicitly.
items.solution: Automatic source detection is disabled and no source paths are registered.

items.subject: tailwind
items.title: A CSS token is not a utility theme token
items.failure: The custom property exists in the browser but no intended bg-brand utility is generated.
items.goal: Use the Tailwind 4 theme mechanism for utility generation.
items.solution: A plain root custom property does not alone register a Tailwind theme utility.

items.subject: tailwind
items.title: A dark selector disagrees with the app
items.failure: The manual theme toggle does not control dark styling as intended.
items.goal: Align the configured dark variant with the application’s actual selector.
items.solution: A data attribute does not automatically change the default dark-variant strategy; configure the intended variant.

items.subject: tailwind
items.title: A shared package is invisible to the build
items.code:
@import "tailwindcss";
/* components with complete class strings live in an ignored external workspace package */
items.failure: Local components style correctly, but packaged components lose their utilities in a clean build.
items.goal: Make source inclusion explicit and test a clean consumer build.
items.solution: Source detection does not automatically cover every ignored/external dependency path.

items.subject: tailwind
items.title: The release build lacks dynamically selected states
items.code: Result
items.failure: Production data selects class names that never existed at build time.
items.goal: Design a bounded style contract and a reproducible build/runtime boundary.
items.solution: A build-time utility compiler cannot generate unbounded future classes; map supported values to complete source candidates or use deliberate runtime CSS variables.

items.subject: sass
items.title: A variable is used before assignment
items.code:
.badge { color: $accent; }
$accent: #135;
items.failure: The Sass compiler reports an undefined variable.
items.goal: Define or import a variable before using it.
items.solution: Sass evaluates variable bindings in order.

items.subject: sass
items.title: An intended combined selector gains a space
items.failure: The generated selector targets an active descendant, not the active button.
items.goal: Generate the intended combined class selector.
items.solution: A nested descendant selector needs the parent selector when the same element should match.

items.subject: sass
items.title: A module variable has no namespace
items.code:
@use "tokens";
.card { color: $primary; }
items.failure: The compiler cannot find primary even though tokens defines it.
items.goal: Use the module’s exported namespace deliberately.
items.solution: use members are namespaced by default.

items.subject: sass
items.title: A default token cannot be configured
items.failure: The module configuration is rejected.
items.goal: Declare intentionally configurable module defaults.
items.solution: A variable must be declared with default to be configurable through use ... with.

items.subject: sass
items.title: A media rule has the wrong unit
items.code:
$breakpoint: 768;
@media (min-width: $breakpoint) { .panel { display: block; } }
items.failure: The generated nonzero min-width is invalid without a length unit.
items.goal: Preserve a valid CSS length through the Sass variable.
items.solution: Sass numbers do not gain CSS length units automatically.

items.subject: sass
items.title: A map lookup becomes empty CSS
items.failure: The intended color declaration disappears from compiled output.
items.goal: Check the token key and define a missing-token policy.
items.solution: The missing map key returns null, which can remove a declaration.

items.subject: sass
items.title: An extend affects an unrelated component
items.failure: The card unexpectedly participates in selectors meant for messages.
items.goal: Choose intentional shared declarations rather than accidental selector coupling.
items.solution: extend unifies matching selectors across the stylesheet; it is not simple property copying.

items.subject: sass
items.title: A loop expands without a bound
items.failure: Compilation recurses until it fails.
items.goal: Provide a terminating recursion or finite loop.
items.solution: The recursive argument never moves toward the base case.

items.subject: sass
items.title: Two entry points disagree on configured state
items.failure: The build cannot reconfigure a module already loaded with different/default configuration.
items.goal: Establish one intentional configuration entry point and forward it safely.
items.solution: A module is loaded once per compilation; configuration must happen before its first load.

items.subject: sass
items.title: Generated utility combinations explode
items.failure: Adding spacing tokens multiplies output size and build time unexpectedly.
items.goal: Estimate generated cardinality, define a supported utility surface, and prevent build-size regressions.
items.solution: Nested Cartesian generation grows cubically; reduce combinations or generate only a bounded necessary set.

items.subject: shadcn
items.title: A component token is undefined
items.code:
.button { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); }
:root { --brand: blue; }
items.failure: A copied component has no intended background or foreground theme colors.
items.goal: Define the tokens consumed by the component.
items.solution: The brand variable is not mapped to the primary token contract.

items.subject: shadcn
items.title: A copied component is no longer updated upstream
items.code:
/* local button.css copied six months ago */
.button:focus-visible { outline: none; }
items.failure: Updating a package does not restore the missing keyboard focus style in the copied component.
items.goal: Trace local component ownership and restore a visible focus indicator.
items.solution: Copied shadcn source is owned locally; package updates do not automatically replace local component code.

items.subject: shadcn
items.title: A color format is wrapped twice
items.code:
:root { --primary: oklch(0.6 0.2 250); }
.button { background: hsl(var(--primary)); }
items.failure: The declaration is invalid after substituting the token.
items.goal: Keep the token value format consistent with its consumer.
items.solution: A complete oklch color cannot be inserted as hsl channel arguments.

items.subject: shadcn
items.title: Dark foreground has no matching background
items.code:
:root { --primary: white; --primary-foreground: black; }
.dark { --primary: black; }
items.failure: Primary text disappears against its dark background.
items.goal: Override related semantic token pairs together.
items.solution: The foreground retains the light-theme value while the background changes.

items.subject: shadcn
items.title: Portal content misses scoped theme tokens
items.failure: The popover differs from the themed app or loses its colors.
items.goal: Make the theme scope include the actual portal host.
items.solution: CSS custom properties inherit through DOM ancestry, not the logical React component tree.

items.subject: shadcn
items.title: The adapter maps the wrong color token
items.code:
@theme inline { --color-primary: var(--brand); }
:root { --primary: blue; }
items.failure: The primary utility resolves through an undefined brand variable in this Tailwind 4 scenario.
items.goal: Map utility theme names to the semantic tokens actually provided.
items.solution: The theme alias points at a token that is never defined.

items.subject: shadcn
items.title: Disabled visuals do not change semantics
items.code:
.button[aria-disabled="true"] { opacity: .5; }
/* rendered element is an anchor with href and no activation guard */
items.failure: The disabled-looking action can still navigate.
items.goal: Use the correct native control or implement the complete unavailable-action contract.
items.solution: aria-disabled communicates state but does not suppress link activation.

items.subject: shadcn
items.title: A custom reset erases accessibility
items.failure: All keyboard focus indicators vanish, including those from copied components.
items.goal: Remove the destructive reset and test visible focus for each state.
items.solution: Global important reset declarations defeat component focus styles.

items.subject: shadcn
items.title: Nested themes leak through a shared overlay host
items.failure: Menus from two differently themed regions lose the correct tenant colors.
items.goal: Define a theme-aware overlay host/propagation design and cross-tenant tests.
items.solution: One global portal host has no automatic ancestry in either local theme scope.

items.subject: shadcn
items.title: A token cycle survives an adapter migration
items.code:
:root { --primary: var(--color-primary); --color-primary: var(--primary); }
.button { background: var(--primary); }
items.failure: A primary background utility resolves invalidly after migration.
items.goal: Separate primitive values, semantic tokens, and utility aliases without cycles.
items.solution: The semantic token and its alias refer back to each other; the computed-value dependency graph is cyclic.

items.subject: python
items.title: Cancellation leaves a lock held
items.code:
async def transfer(lock, ledger):
    await lock.acquire()
    await ledger.flush()
    lock.release()
items.failure: Canceling the task during flush can leave every later transfer waiting forever.
items.goal: Trace cancellation at each suspension point, guarantee release, and test a canceled flush.
items.solution: Lock release must be guaranteed by an async context manager or finally block, including cancellation.

items.subject: python
items.title: A cache creates duplicate external effects
items.code:
async def reserve(key):
    if key not in cache:
        cache[key] = await external_reservation(key)
    return cache[key]
items.failure: Concurrent calls for the same key both perform the external reservation; cancellation can leave an uncertain outcome.
items.goal: Design single-flight coordination plus durable idempotency and failure/cancellation cleanup.
items.solution: The check and awaited effect are not atomic; a local cache alone cannot provide durable exactly-once external operations.

items.subject: typescript
items.title: An exhaustive switch silently misses a new variant
items.failure: A deleted event is accepted by the type checker but produces undefined; a later schema extension creates more silent omissions.
items.goal: Make missing variants compile-time visible and define runtime input validation separately.
items.solution: A union does not force exhaustive handling; an explicit never assertion/return contract is needed, and untrusted data still needs validation.

items.subject: typescript
items.title: A canceled response replaces newer state
items.failure: Searching A then B can end with A’s slow response; aborting one request does not cover every timing window.
items.goal: Design a request-version ownership check across both awaits, cancellation, and unmount.
items.solution: Asynchronous responses need a current-request identity guard; types alone do not establish ordering.

items.subject: c
items.title: A published pointer loses its owner
items.failure: A reader can dereference old after another thread frees it despite atomic pointer operations.
items.goal: Specify a safe reclamation/ownership protocol and an adversarial interleaving test.
items.solution: Atomic publication does not preserve the pointee lifetime; reclamation requires coordinated reader ownership.

items.subject: c
items.title: A length computation wraps before allocation
items.failure: An attacker-controlled count can wrap bytes and cause writes beyond the allocation.
items.goal: Check arithmetic, source bounds and allocation failure before copying.
items.solution: Multiplication may overflow size_t; validate count against SIZE_MAX/sizeof(Item), capacities and allocation results.

items.subject: cpp
items.title: A vector reference is invalidated
items.failure: The reference is used after a reallocation invalidated it.
items.goal: Keep references within their valid lifetime.
items.solution: reserve that increases capacity invalidates existing element references.

items.subject: cpp
items.title: An apparently safe pointer races with destruction
items.failure: Atomic head access is race-free but a concurrent reader can use a deleted object.
items.goal: Define lifetime reclamation and memory-order assumptions independently.
items.solution: Atomic raw-pointer operations do not provide ownership or safe reclamation.

items.subject: cpp
items.title: A strong exception guarantee is broken
items.failure: A failure in credit leaves only the debit committed.
items.goal: Design an all-or-nothing state transition, including rollback failure behavior.
items.solution: Sequential mutation does not provide a strong exception guarantee; establish a no-throw commit or reliable staged state.

items.subject: rust
items.title: A mutex guard crosses an await
items.failure: The future may not satisfy Send requirements, and holding a blocking mutex across a suspension can stall other work.
items.goal: Minimize lock lifetime and define which state must be revalidated after the await.
items.solution: The standard mutex guard spans an await; copy the necessary state, release it, then reacquire and revalidate, or use an appropriate async synchronization design.

items.subject: rust
items.title: A pinned self-reference is moved before use
items.failure: After grow reallocates the String, dereferencing ptr is invalid even if the outer Buffer is pinned.
items.goal: State the exact pointee-lifetime invariant and design mutation/ownership restrictions.
items.solution: Pinning an outer object does not prevent a String’s internal allocation from changing; the stored pointer can dangle.

items.subject: ruby
items.title: A nested transaction leaks an external event
items.code:
Order.transaction do
 order.save!
 publish_event(order.id)
 reserve_stock! # raises
end
items.failure: The database rolls back but the published event cannot be recalled.
items.goal: Define a durable post-commit/outbox and idempotent delivery contract.
items.solution: Database transactions do not roll back external publication.

items.subject: ruby
items.title: A synchronized cache still computes twice
items.failure: Two callers both execute expensive_effect for the same missing key.
items.goal: Coordinate in-flight work without serializing all keys and handle failure/cancellation cleanup.
items.solution: The lock protects individual cache operations, not the entire miss-computation-publication lifecycle.

items.subject: embedded-c
items.title: DMA sees stale bytes
items.failure: On the stated target with a non-coherent write-back data cache, DMA sometimes reads stale memory.
items.goal: Define ownership, target-specific cache maintenance, alignment and ordering using the actual MCU documentation; do not run on hardware.
items.solution: CPU cache dirtiness and DMA visibility are separate; correct maintenance depends on the specific target and ownership protocol.

items.subject: embedded-c
items.title: An interrupt publishes before the payload
items.failure: The code assumes volatile is a portable inter-context ordering and atomicity contract.
items.goal: Specify the actual compiler/MCU guarantees and a bounded synchronization protocol before deployment.
items.solution: Volatile alone is not a general C memory-order or atomicity primitive; choose a target-supported ISR/foreground protocol.

items.subject: embedded-python
items.title: An IRQ allocates unpredictably
items.failure: A MicroPython hard IRQ attempts to allocate as the list grows.
items.goal: Use a bounded preallocated handoff with an explicit overflow policy; reason in simulation.
items.solution: Hard IRQs must avoid heap allocation; append can resize and the data source may allocate too.

items.subject: embedded-python
items.title: A scheduled callback monopolizes execution
items.failure: The callback never returns, starving other scheduled/foreground work.
items.goal: Bound each callback and define how future work is rescheduled.
items.solution: Being scheduled does not make an unbounded callback cooperative.

items.subject: embedded-python
items.title: A ring counter eventually leaves small-int range
items.code:
buffer = bytearray(128)
head = 0
def irq(pin):
    global head
    buffer[head % 128] = pin.value()
    head += 1
items.failure: The hard-IRQ counter grows without bound and may eventually require heap allocation; unread data can also be overwritten.
items.goal: Bound indices and define producer/consumer synchronization and full-buffer behavior.
items.solution: A modulo index does not bound the counter itself; large integer growth and overflow policy remain unsolved.

items.subject: embedded-python
items.title: Two owners reuse a DMA buffer
items.failure: On the stated API that retains the buffer until completion, later writes corrupt in-flight transfers.
items.goal: Define a bounded buffer ownership state machine and completion/error recovery; do not exercise real hardware.
items.solution: Asynchronous submission is not transfer completion; a buffer cannot be mutated while the peripheral still owns it.

items.subject: python
items.title: A context manager swallows failure
items.failure: The caller never observes a failed operation.
items.goal: Trace exception propagation through yield and specify when suppression is intentional.
items.solution: The generator catches and suppresses every Exception; resource cleanup should not silently erase an operation failure.

items.subject: python
items.title: An exit hook masks the original error
items.code:
class Session:
    def __enter__(self): return self
    def __exit__(self, kind, value, traceback):
        self.close()
        return True
    def close(self): pass

with Session():
    raise RuntimeError("write failed")
items.failure: Code after the with statement runs as though the write succeeded.
items.goal: Preserve operation failures while guaranteeing cleanup.
items.solution: A truthy return from __exit__ suppresses the exception passed to it.

items.subject: c
items.title: A header creates duplicate definitions
items.failure: The linker reports multiple definitions of global_count.
items.goal: Separate the shared declaration from its one definition and explain translation-unit boundaries.
items.solution: A definition in a commonly included header creates multiple external definitions; use an extern declaration and one source definition.

items.subject: c
items.title: Compilation succeeds but linking fails
items.failure: The object file is created, but producing an executable later reports an undefined reference.
items.goal: Distinguish declarations, definitions, compilation and linking; specify a complete build.
items.solution: A function declaration permits compilation; the linker still needs the object/library containing its definition.

items.subject: c
items.title: A pointer outlives automatic storage
items.failure: The caller uses an address whose object lifetime has ended.
items.goal: Specify ownership and storage duration, and design a valid return contract.
items.solution: The returned pointer points into automatic storage that no longer exists after return.

items.subject: c
items.title: An array parameter loses its extent
items.failure: The function does not compute the number of elements in its caller’s array.
items.goal: Explain parameter adjustment and make the extent part of the function contract.
items.solution: An array parameter is adjusted to a pointer; sizeof measures that pointer, not the original array.

items.subject: c
items.title: A supposed overflow check comes too late
items.failure: Under the stated C17 signed-integer contract, incrementing INT_MAX is already undefined before the comparison.
items.goal: Check the precondition before the arithmetic and explain optimizer assumptions.
items.solution: Signed overflow is undefined; a later comparison cannot reliably detect an operation that already has undefined behavior.

items.subject: c
items.title: A shift assumes signed wraparound
items.failure: Under the stated C17 contract, this is not a portable signed doubling operation.
items.goal: State the valid operand/range conditions and choose a checked arithmetic or unsigned-bit contract.
items.solution: Left-shifting a negative signed operand has undefined behavior in C17; unsigned bit operations and checked signed arithmetic have different contracts.

items.subject: ruby
items.title: Trace raise error block
items.code:
it "rejects out-of-range vertices" do
  expect(graph.add_edge(0, 5)).to raise_error(ArgumentError)
end
items.failure:
What is wrong with this example?
1. expect cannot take a method call as its argument, only a local variable or a literal value
2. The call runs before expect sees it, so the error escapes; raise_error needs a block
3. raise_error is not an RSpec matcher, so the example fails to load before it runs
4. ArgumentError cannot be matched by a matcher, only by a rescue clause inside the example
items.goal: Trace the program and justify its output, type error, or state changes. Do not assume every snippet contains a bug; support your diagnosis with an execution trace.
items.solution:
1
expect(value) evaluates its argument first. A matcher such as raise_error has to run the code itself, so it needs expect { ... } with braces. Parentheses are for values.

class Ring:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.buf = bytearray(n)
        self.size = n
        self.head = 0
        self.tail = 0
        self.count = 0
    def push(self, b):
        self.buf[self.head] = b
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % self.size
        self.count = min(self.count + 1, self.size)

items.solution:
import time, network
def connect(ssid, pw, timeout_ms=10000):
    wlan = network.WLAN(network.STA_IF)
    wlan.active(True)
    wlan.connect(ssid, pw)
    start = time.ticks_ms()
    while not wlan.isconnected():
        if time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), start) > timeout_ms:
            return None
        time.sleep_ms(100)
    return wlan

def quicksort(a):

        return a
    p = random.choice(a)

            + quicksort([x for x in a if x > p]))

def shortest_path(g, src, dst)
  parent = { src => nil }
  queue = [src]
  until queue.empty?
    v = queue.shift
    break if v == dst
    g.neighbors(v).each do |n|
      next if parent.key?(n)
      parent[n] = v
      queue.push(n)
    end
  end
  return nil unless parent.key?(dst)
  path = [dst]
  path << parent[path.last] until path.last == src
  path.reverse
end

def topo_sort(g)
  indeg = Hash.new(0)
  g.vertices.each { |v| g.neighbors(v).each { |n| indeg[n] += 1 } }
  queue = g.vertices.select { |v| indeg[v].zero? }
  order = []
  until queue.empty?
    v = queue.shift
    order << v
    g.neighbors(v).each do |n|
      indeg[n] -= 1
      queue.push(n) if indeg[n].zero?
    end
  end
  order.size == g.vertices.size ? order : nil

items.solution:
class AVLNode
  attr_accessor :key, :left, :right, :height
  def initialize(key)
    @key = key
    @height = 1
  end
end
class AVL
  include Enumerable
  attr_reader :root, :size
  def initialize
    @root = nil
    @size = 0
  end
  def insert(key)
    @root = insert_at(@root, key)
    self
  end
  def height
    height_of(@root)
  end
  def each(&block)
    return to_enum(:each) unless block
    walk(@root, &block)
    self
  end
  private
  def height_of(node)
    node ? node.height : 0
  end
  def update(node)
    node.height = 1 + [height_of(node.left), height_of(node.right)].max
  end
  def balance(node)
    height_of(node.left) - height_of(node.right)
  end
  def rotate_right(y)
    x = y.left
    y.left = x.right
    x.right = y
    update(y)
    update(x)
    x
  end
  def rotate_left(x)
    y = x.right
    x.right = y.left
    y.left = x
    update(x)
    update(y)
    y
  end
  def rebalance(node)
    update(node)
    b = balance(node)
    if b > 1
      node.left = rotate_left(node.left) if balance(node.left) < 0
      return rotate_right(node)
    elsif b < -1
      node.right = rotate_right(node.right) if balance(node.right) > 0
      return rotate_left(node)
    end
    node
  end
  def insert_at(node, key)
    if node.nil?
      @size += 1
      return AVLNode.new(key)
    end
    if key < node.key
      node.left = insert_at(node.left, key)
    elsif key > node.key
      node.right = insert_at(node.right, key)
    else
      return node
    end
    rebalance(node)
  end
  def walk(node, &block)
    return unless node
    walk(node.left, &block)
    block.call(node.key)
    walk(node.right, &block)
  end
end

def kth_smallest(root, k)
  stack = []
  node = root
  while node || !stack.empty?
    while node
      stack.push(node)
      node = node.left
    end
    node = stack.pop
    k -= 1
    return node.key if k.zero?
    node = node.right

class NamedSets
  def initialize
    @parent = Hash.new { |h, k| h[k] = k }
    @size = Hash.new(1)
  end
  def find(x)
    root = x
    root = @parent[root] while @parent[root] != root
    while @parent[x] != root
      nxt = @parent[x]
      @parent[x] = root
      x = nxt
    end
    root
  end
  def union(a, b)
    ra = find(a)
    rb = find(b)
    return false if ra == rb
    ra, rb = rb, ra if @size[ra] < @size[rb]

    @size[ra] += @size[rb]
    true
  end
  def groups
    @parent.keys.group_by { |k| find(k) }.values.map(&:sort).sort
  end
  def sets_count
    groups.size
  end
end

class DList

  attr_reader :head, :tail, :size

    @tail = DNode.new
    @head.next = @tail
    @tail.prev = @head
    @size = 0
