  def link_after(node, fresh)
    fresh.prev = node
    fresh.next = node.next
    node.next.prev = fresh
    node.next = fresh

    insert_after(@head, v)
  end
  def push_back(v)
    insert_after(@tail.prev, v)
  end
  def each
    return to_enum(:each) unless block_given?
    node = @head.next
    until node.equal?(@tail)
      yield node.value
      node = node.next
    end
  end
  def reverse_each
    return to_enum(:reverse_each) unless block_given?
    node = @tail.prev
    until node.equal?(@head)
      yield node.value
      node = node.prev
    end
  end
end

class Fenwick
  attr_reader :size, :tree
  def initialize(n)
    @size = n
    @tree = Array.new(n + 1, 0)

end

items.failure: A teammate claims: The ordering block can return a boolean such as a > b.
items.goal: Find a counterexample or failing execution trace, diagnose the defect, and propose a regression test. The snippet may need its usual imports or enclosing program.
items.solution:
class PQ
  def initialize(&cmp)
    @cmp = cmp || proc { |a, b| a <=> b }
    @a = []
  end
  def size
    @a.size
  end
  def empty?
    @a.empty?
  end
  def peek
    @a.first
  end
  def push(v)
    @a.push(v)
    sift_up(@a.size - 1)
    self
  end
  def pop
    return nil if @a.empty?
    top = @a[0]
    last = @a.pop
    unless @a.empty?
      @a[0] = last
      sift_down(0)
    end
    top
  end
  private
  def before?(i, j)
    @cmp.call(@a[i], @a[j]) < 0
  end
  def sift_up(i)
    while i > 0
      parent = (i - 1) / 2
      break unless before?(i, parent)
      @a[i], @a[parent] = @a[parent], @a[i]
      i = parent
    end
  end
  def sift_down(i)
    n = @a.size
    loop do
      l = 2 * i + 1
      r = l + 1
      first = i
      first = l if l < n && before?(l, first)
      first = r if r < n && before?(r, first)
      break if first == i
      @a[first], @a[i] = @a[i], @a[first]
      i = first
    end
  end
end

items.solution:
def dijkstra(graph, src)
  dist = Hash.new(Float::INFINITY)
  dist[src] = 0
  q = PQ.new { |a, b| a[0] <=> b[0] }
  q.push([0, src])
  until q.empty?
    d, u = q.pop
    next if d > dist[u]
    graph[u].each do |v, w|
      nd = d + w
      next unless nd < dist[v]
      dist[v] = nd
      q.push([nd, v])
    end
  end
  dist
end

class QNode
  attr_accessor :value, :next
  def initialize(value)
    @value = value
  end
end
class LinkedQueue
  include Enumerable
  attr_reader :size
  def initialize
    @head = @tail = nil
    @size = 0
  end
  def enqueue(v)
    node = QNode.new(v)
    if @tail
      @tail.next = node
    else
      @head = node
    end
    @tail = node
    @size += 1
    self
  end
  def dequeue
    return nil unless @head
    v = @head.value
    @head = @head.next
    @tail = nil unless @head
    @size -= 1
    v
  end
  def front
    @head && @head.value
  end
  def empty?
    @size.zero?
  end
  def each
    return to_enum(:each) unless block_given?
    node = @head
    while node
      yield node.value
      node = node.next
    end
  end
end

items.solution:
class RBNode
  attr_accessor :key, :left, :right, :red
  def initialize(key, red = true)
    @key = key
    @red = red
  end
end
class RBTree
  include Enumerable
  attr_reader :root, :size
  def initialize
    @root = nil
    @size = 0
  end
  def insert(key)
    @root = insert_at(@root, key)
    @root.red = false
    self
  end
  def height(node = @root)
    node ? 1 + [height(node.left), height(node.right)].max : 0
  end
  def each(&block)
    return to_enum(:each) unless block
    walk(@root, &block)
    self
  end
  private
  def red?(node)
    !node.nil? && node.red
  end
  def rotate_left(h)
    x = h.right
    h.right = x.left
    x.left = h
    x.red = h.red
    h.red = true
    x
  end
  def rotate_right(h)
    x = h.left
    h.left = x.right
    x.right = h
    x.red = h.red
    h.red = true
    x
  end
  def flip_colors(h)
    h.red = true
    h.left.red = false
    h.right.red = false
  end
  def insert_at(h, key)
    if h.nil?
      @size += 1
      return RBNode.new(key)
    end
    if key < h.key
      h.left = insert_at(h.left, key)
    elsif key > h.key
      h.right = insert_at(h.right, key)
    end
    h = rotate_left(h) if red?(h.right) && !red?(h.left)
    h = rotate_right(h) if red?(h.left) && red?(h.left.left)
    flip_colors(h) if red?(h.left) && red?(h.right)
    h
  end
  def walk(node, &block)
    return unless node
    walk(node.left, &block)
    block.call(node.key)
    walk(node.right, &block)
  end
end

class Trie
  def delete(word)
    existing = find(word)
    return false unless existing && existing.terminal
    node = @root
    word.each_char do |ch|
      child = node.children[ch]
      child.pass -= 1
      if child.pass.zero?
        node.children.delete(ch)
        @size -= 1
        return true
      end
      node = child
    end
    node.terminal = false
    @size -= 1
    true
  end
end

class TrieNode
  attr_reader :children
  attr_accessor :terminal, :pass
  def initialize
    @children = {}
    @terminal = false
    @pass = 0
  end
end
class Trie
  attr_reader :root, :size
  def initialize
    @root = TrieNode.new
    @size = 0
  end
  def insert(word)
    existing = find(word)
    return false if existing && existing.terminal
    node = @root
    word.each_char do |ch|
      node = (node.children[ch] ||= TrieNode.new)
      node.pass += 1
    end
    node.terminal = true
    @size += 1
    true
  end
  private
  def find(str)
    node = @root
    str.each_char do |ch|
      node = node.children[ch]
      return nil unless node
    end
    node
  end
end
